title: Ar-Rahman, the Most Merciful
hook: the Most Merciful, mercy vast enough for all creation, even the people who made this week hard
tomorrow: mercy for everything. but does it ever find just one person?

segments.voice: Yesterday, the ninety-nine: counted on beads, or on fingertips that will be made to speak. Every name a door. Today, the first one.

A rough week leaves a list: the teacher who snapped, the driver who cut you off, the group chat that went cold for no reason. Box one on yesterday's grid gets a name big enough to cover every person on that list, and you. Ar-Rahman. In Pickthall's English, the Beneficent. It's the first name in Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim, the words that open surah after surah.
screen: `THE LIST FROM A ROUGH WEEK.` → `BOX ONE.` → `AR-RAHMAN.`

segments.voice: The name comes from the root of mercy, r-h-m. Here's how big it is, in a hadith Bukhari and Muslim record, in paraphrase. The Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, said: Allah made mercy in a hundred parts. He kept ninety-nine with Himself and sent one part down to earth. From that one part, creatures show mercy to each other, so that a mare lifts her hoof away from her foal, afraid of hurting it. That's the thing to tell a friend tonight: every kind act you've ever seen, a nurse at three in the morning, a stranger holding a door, a horse stepping carefully, comes from one part in a hundred. Ar-Rahman is the name for the whole. In Surah al-A'raf, Pickthall has: and My mercy embraceth all things. All things includes the teacher who snapped. That doesn't make what he did fine; the Qur'an speaks of justice too. It means nobody on this week's list was standing outside the reach of that mercy. Neither were you. That can change how a hard week ends: not with a verdict, but with a wider view.
screen: `MERCY IN A HUNDRED PARTS.` · `ONE PART SENT DOWN.` · `THE MARE LIFTS HER HOOF.` · `IT EMBRACES ALL THINGS.` · then, large: `MERCY FOR ALL.`

segments.voice: Look around for one thing that's here because someone was kind: a gift, a meal, a chair somebody carried in. Rest your eyes on it for the sit. Let it count as a trace of that one part sent down.
screen: `ONE KIND THING NEARBY.` · `A TRACE OF THE ONE PART.`

fork.setup: a coworker blamed you for her mistake in front of everyone, then acted normal the next day. what does Ar-Rahman's mercy say about her?
options: she's outside mercy until she apologizes.
mercy reaches her too; that doesn't make what she did okay.

fork.reveal: My mercy embraceth all things: the person who wronged you is inside its reach. that isn't the same as calling the wrong right.

options: Give him a little room. Mercy covers him too, even if 'ok' stung.
Call it out tonight. He owes you a real answer, and mercy can wait.
